conviction_note: H1 looks set to land on or just above the company plan and about level with IFIS consensus (pretax 7,400 against a 7,217 plan), so the quarter adds little. What is left is whether the full year (FY) forecast is raised. The street already sits 3.2% above plan on FY, so a held forecast is a mild disappointment and a raise of the FY24-FY26 kind is a mild positive. This name's post-release reactions lean up (6 of 8), and the stock is +12% over 20 days on a sector read-through from BayCurrent, which offsets that lean. The findings sum to +0.3 and the scaled number is +0.32 (p_up 54 on abs 4.0), so the two measurements agree: close to a non-result with a slight positive lean.
bar: IFIS consensus (kabuyoho.jp/report?bcode=4373, read 2026-10-28): H1 pretax 7,400m yen and FY pretax 17,487m yen, against the company's H1 pretax 7,217m / OP 7,350m / revenue 33,200m and FY pretax 16,943m / OP 17,200m (unchanged at Q1, 決算短信 2026-07-27, https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260727/140120260727599730.pdf). My H1 estimate: revenue about 33.3bn and OP about 7.4-7.5bn, so pretax about 7.3-7.4bn, -0.5% to the consensus bar and +1-3% to plan. The consensus comes from one aggregator, so findings that depend on it are capped small.

findings.finding: Q1 FY3/27 OP of 3,427m is 46.6% of the 7,350m H1 plan (revenue 48.6%), and the plan's own structure makes a small H1 beat likely. The company plans 45.0% gross margin every quarter (Q1 actual 46.3%) and spreads SG&A and R&D evenly across quarters, with new-graduate training loaded into Q1. Q2 is seasonally stronger for consulting (FY26 Q2 OP was 19.6% above Q1). Expected H1 OP is about 7.4-7.5bn, +1-3% to plan, which is roughly the IFIS H1 consensus already.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The Q1 print with no revision (2026-07-27, 15:30) moved -0.17% to the next close. Q2 FY3/25 (2024-10-30), an in-line quarter with a revenue-only raise, moved +4.21% the next day.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced already. IFIS H1 pretax consensus of 7,400 is 2.5% above the 7,217 plan, so the street holds this beat. What remains is the possibility that Q2 repeats last year's +19.6% step-up over Q1, which would land about 2% above consensus. If the market expected more, the consensus would sit further above plan.
findings.independence: Company 決算短信 Q1 (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260727/140120260727599730.pdf) gives the same progress figures, so this is one fact set. The IFIS consensus (https://kabuyoho.jp/report?bcode=4373) is the independent read and it agrees.

findings.finding: Revision record and the FY bar. The FY plan (OP 17,200m) needs H2 OP of 9,850m, +34% year on year, and was not raised at Q1. That breaks the FY26 pattern of raises at every print (Q1, Q2 and Q3, 2025-07-30, 10-30 and 2026-01-29), but FY25 was also raised at Q2 (revenue only). Inputs to the decision: mid-career hiring at 182 by July against a 250-300 full-year plan and orders +31%, against attrition of 10% vs 9% planned and AI usage cost about 100m over plan. A dividend raise needs an FY profit raise, because 24 yen is already a 43.6% payout against a 40% policy. A buyback is discretionary; the last one was in Jan 2026 at about 940 yen, alongside a raise. Street FY pretax is already +3.2% above plan, so a hold disappoints mildly and a raise of the FY26 kind (+2-4%) pays.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Prints with an upward revision: 2024-10-30 +4.21%; 2025-07-30 (15:00 release) about +7.6% from 15:00 to the next close; 2025-10-30 (raise, 増配 and split) +5.65%; 2026-01-29 (raise and buyback) +1.37%. The Q1 hold on 2026-07-27 moved -0.17%.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced. Consensus already sits 3.2% above plan, the stock is at its high, and the 20-day run-up is +12%. The unpriced part is the sign of the company's decision. Its history is mixed (FY24 never revised, FY25 revenue only, FY26 three times), and nobody can see the board's choice before 15:30.
findings.independence: Revision documents: https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20251030/140120251030582271.pdf and https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260129/140120260129540999.pdf. Hiring and attrition come from the logmi transcript, the same document as finding 1.

findings.finding: The 20-day run-up of +12% is sector-led and already holds a strong-print expectation. Simplex rose +5.2% to 1,265 on 2026-10-16 on 'information-services sector strength' when BayCurrent jumped 17% on results and a new mid-term plan, and IT-services take-private premiums (電通総研 by VIC on 8/28, when Simplex rose +5.5%) lift the group. The stock sits near its all-time high with a margin long ratio of 2.34.

findings.why_not_priced: This is a statement about what IS priced. The read-through is in the price, so the bar for a positive reaction is higher than the plan alone implies. It is a proxy and close to the free control, so it is sized small.

findings.finding: Cost headwinds named in the Q1 briefing could hold back a FY raise: attrition rose to 10% (trailing four quarters) against a 9% plan, R&D/AI usage came in about 100m over plan in Q1, and revenue per head dips from Q2 as new graduates join projects in August.
